title: Calendar and itinerary
scopeNote: Only permitted Case viewings and property-work photography are included. My appointments shows you as the recorded host.
manualNote: The agency calendar records internal commitments. Check external calendars manually before confirmation; automatic calendar sync is not available.
snapshotNote: Refresh before acting. A proposal does not reserve resources; confirmation rechecks the current arrangement.
adjusted: Some calendar filters were invalid. Review the displayed date, timezone and scope before continuing.
failure: The calendar could not be read
failureNote: Availability was not checked. Refresh with these filters to try again.
emptyNote: Choose another period or permitted scope. Requests without an arrangement are separate and cover all dates.
emptyDay: No arrangements on this page for this day.
mobileNote: Every view includes the complete agenda below. Open a viewing to enter or change its time with the scheduling form.
incomplete: The full internal resource reservation is not recorded. Review this viewing before relying on the arrangement.
overlap: The proposed time overlaps a permitted internal reservation, including its travel allowance
proposalNote: This is a scoped overlap preview, not an availability approval. The proposal has no reserved travel allowance; confirmation checks all resources and buffers again.
externalMissing: A manual external-busy check is required before confirmation.
bounded: This page shows up to 50 permitted appointments. Use the page controls for the rest of this period.
requestsNote: These requests have no confirmed or proposed interval and are not filtered by date. Open a request to review its preferred windows and enter an arrangement.
noRequests: No requests awaiting a time on this page in the selected scope.
subtitle: Viewings and property photography, host time and access, in one place.
timelineNote: Blank time does not indicate availability.
heading: Calendar
canvasEmpty: No viewings recorded in this period
transitionNote: When clocks change, each column shows that day's local times and offsets.
